question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: **

The **tableau **of human suffering was etched into memory by the war artist.

options.text: The group performed a silent tableau on stage.
The historian examined the tableau of events after partition.
The tableau included metaphorical symbols and figures.
The cabinet's tableau was rearranged after the reshuffle.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tableau"** refers to a group of models or figures arranged to represent a scene or event, often displayed artistically. (चित्रमय दृश्य)

 
 
• **Example:** The artist created a tableau depicting the struggles of humanity during the war.
 

 
• A homonym refers to a word that is spelled and pronounced the same as another word but has a different meaning. In this context, the highlighted word "tableau" is used to refer to a static artistic representation, whereas in Option 4, it refers to the arrangement of the cabinet.

 
 
• **Example:** The cabinet's tableau was rearranged after the reshuffle. (Here, "tableau" refers to the arrangement of figures or items.)
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The group performed a silent tableau on stage. (चित्रमय दृश्य)

 
 
• **Explanation:** In this sentence, "tableau" refers to a live artistic performance representing a scene.
 
• **Example:** The actors stood motionless in a tableau, conveying the story without words.
 

 
• **Option 2:** The historian examined the tableau of events after partition. (घटनाओं का चित्रण)

 
 
• **Explanation:** In this sentence, "tableau" refers to a figurative representation of events or situations.
 
• **Example:** The tableau of historical incidents was carefully documented by the scholar.
 

 
• **Option 3:** The tableau included metaphorical symbols and figures. (सांकेतिक प्रतीक और आकृतियों से निर्मित दृश्य)

 
 
• **Explanation:** Here, "tableau" refers to an artistic arrangement containing symbols and figures.
 
• **Example:** The tableau illustrated the theme of unity through abstract elements.
 

40:T804,

The correct answer is **Option 1**.
